data.title: bn-1cl: Safe packed-shell diagnostic surface
data.description: For bn-1cl: install frozen read-only status/screenState/audioState before async boot, cover lifecycle/frame/input/palette/audio evidence without exposing engine controls, add structural tests/docs, and validate an actual packed Lantern page in Chromium. Full just check passes.

data.body: HIGH: Post-boot callback exceptions bypass the only catch and leave a false ready snapshot. frame() runs as a requestAnimationFrame callback, so the async initializer catch at the bottom cannot catch exceptions from con_step, pushAudio, currentError, or blit; resetConsole is likewise an event callback. The exception also exits before scheduling the next frame while rafPending remains true, so RESET will not restart the loop. Chromium reproducer on a packed Lantern page: after ready at successfulFrames=29, replace CanvasRenderingContext2D.prototype.putImageData with a function that throws; after 500 ms status still reports phase=ready, error=null, dead=false, successfulFrames=30 even though the browser recorded the uncaught error and rendering stopped. Wrap the entire frame body and reset path in failure containment that sets phase=failed (or halted only for a latched cart error), sets error/dead consistently, clears the loop-active flag, and add a browser-level regression that injects a throwing render dependency.

data.reason: Unexpected rAF/reset callback exceptions escape diagnostics, leave phase ready with no error, and strand the render loop.

data.body: Fixed in c54dafd: frame and reset callbacks now contain all unexpected exceptions through shellFailure, which latches phase=failed/error/dead and clears rafPending. New real-Chromium diagnostics smoke injects putImageData failures into both rAF and reset paths, verifies actionable snapshots and a stopped loop, and fails explicitly without browser prerequisites. Full just check and browser-diagnostics pass.

Verified in c54dafd. frame now delegates through a try/catch, resetConsole contains its full init/state/blit/reschedule path, and shellFailure consistently latches dead=true, rafPending=false, phase=failed, plus stack-backed error text. The new real-browser regression exercises both the rAF blit failure and paused RESET failure. I ran it with /home/bob/.cache/ms-playwright/chromium-1217/chrome-linux64/chrome: all ten assertions passed, including stable stopped frame count. node --check, console-pack tests, workspace clippy -D warnings, and diff check also pass.

data.reason: Fixed and independently verified in code and real Chromium.
LGTM after c54dafd: callback failures are contained and both rAF/reset paths pass the real-Chromium regression.
